content: Customer Pranav Mishra reports his policy was cancelled, provides policy number SH-123456, and cites missed payment due to unforeseen circumstances. Agent Neha Kapoor explains the cancellation is final due to non‑payment and offers to help him apply for a new policy. Pranav asks for a discount on the new policy as a previous customer.

action_items: Agent to guide customer through new policy application
Agent to consider offering discount for new policy
